blocks.x: No. No, they only had the tuxedo. That's Mike DeLay. And, Gene, Gene Ware, you ever heard of him? Mm-hmm. Yeah, piano player. I don't know. Gene Ware?

Gene Hall, I know Gene Hall. Yeah, piano. Yeah, and somebody else, I forgot that was a tuxedo. Where was that? That was around in there behind, the southern station on Canal Street at that time. Used to have a station on Canal Street.
Yeah, around in that, somewhere in that area. Mm-hmm. I used to go around and listen at them. Yeah.
I heard Renee at the Brown Derby there. Yeah, there.
Mm-hmm. Joe and Joseph's brother was on Canal and Crown there.
Which brother was that? Willie Joseph. Kaiser. That's what we call him, Kaiser. Yeah.
When was that that he was there?
Kaiser was there around the late 20s. The late 20s. I know him right. Mm-hmm.
Yeah, I'm just trying to remember when you came here. You came here in 25. I came here in 25.
How did you get the name Kaiser?
I don't know. I started calling him. He was a fine client player.
Oh, yeah. Mm-hmm. Yeah, he was like, uh, well, I guess in World War I, everyone was talking about the Kaiser.
